title: Member-Tier Discount on Northgate TV Delivery & Wall-Mount Installation Mounting
content:
A member-tier discount applies to the Northgate Delivery & Installation wall-mounting charge at the Northgate TV Delivery & Wall-Mount Installation level. It follows the membership presented on the purchase being delivered, its tier and its opened date as Northgate Memberships records them.

| Membership presented on the purchase | Member-tier discount |
|---|---|
| Northgate Club Plus Membership or Northgate Business Plus Membership | 15 percent |
| Any other membership opened 120 or more whole months before today | 10 percent |
| Any other membership opened fewer than 120 whole months before today | Nothing |

The discount reduces the surcharged amount: the priced labor with any percentage added to it. Percentage discounts on the wall-mounting charge are added together into one total rate, and the surcharged amount is reduced once by that total rate; the discounts do not act successively.

## Decision points

- A Plus membership takes 15 percent however long it has been open.
- A membership that is not Plus takes 10 percent at 120 whole months and nothing at 119.

**Hypothetical figure.** A surcharged amount of $400.00 reduced by a total rate of 15 percent becomes $340.00.
